memberships.lcRenewHelp: Continues access into a new period — early renewal keeps remaining days (REN-1).
memberships.lcUpgradeHelp: The current period runs unchanged; the new plan starts the day after it ends (UPG-1).
memberships.lcFreezeHelp: Pauses the clock; the end date extends by the frozen days on resume (FRZ-2).
memberships.lcCancelHelp: Ends access immediately and can’t be undone — create a new membership instead (REN-4).
